seoTitle: GoDaddy Website Builder: How to Use It & Plan Pricing
metaDescription: Compare GoDaddy Website Builder's Basic, Standard, Premium, and Ecommerce plans and learn how to build and publish a site with the drag-and-drop tool.
intro: Whether you're creating a personal blog, a business site, or a full online store, GoDaddy's Website Builder offers a drag-and-drop way to design and publish without needing to code. This guide covers using the builder and comparing the Basic, Standard, Premium, and Ecommerce plans.

steps.heading: Choose a starting template
steps.body: Pick a template that fits your site's purpose, whether that's a blog, business page, or online store, as your starting point in the builder.

steps.heading: Customize your site with the drag-and-drop tools
steps.body: Use the builder's editing tools to adjust layout, text, images, and branding to match your vision.

steps.heading: Compare the available plans
steps.body: Review what's included across Basic, Standard, Premium, and Ecommerce, since each tier unlocks different features like SEO tools, appointment booking, and selling capabilities.

steps.heading: Select the plan that fits your needs
steps.body: Choose the plan tier based on whether you need a simple site or advanced ecommerce functionality.

steps.heading: Publish your site
steps.body: Once your design and plan are set, publish the site so it becomes live and accessible to visitors.

faq.question: What's the difference between the Basic and Premium plans?
faq.answer: Premium generally unlocks more advanced tools like appointment booking and marketing email compared to the more limited Basic tier.

faq.question: Do I need the Ecommerce plan to sell products?
faq.answer: Yes, selling products typically requires the Ecommerce plan, which includes the store and checkout functionality the other tiers lack.

faq.question: Is coding knowledge required to use GoDaddy Website Builder?
faq.answer: No, it's designed as a drag-and-drop tool, so no coding experience is needed to build and publish a site.

faq.question: Can I upgrade my plan later as my site grows?
faq.answer: Yes, you can typically upgrade to a higher-tier plan if your needs expand beyond what your current plan offers.
